product_overview: North Star Advisory is a B2B landing page that helps visitors assess growth friction through a diagnostic calculator and submit enterprise lead inquiries through a secure contact form. The page also provides navigation to key sections and a WhatsApp sharing path for diagnostic results.
core_goals: Assess operational growth friction through a multi-step diagnostic
Review EBITDA yield and severity results from the diagnostic
Submit an enterprise lead inquiry through the contact form
Navigate quickly between major sections of the landing page

features.name: Growth Friction Index (GFI) Diagnostic
features.description: A 3-step calculator that helps users evaluate operational revenue leakage and view an EBITDA yield result with a severity score.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select measurement input option -> Select visibility input option -> Select velocity input option -> View resulting EBITDA Yield and severity score

Navigate to / -> Select measurement input option -> Select visibility input option -> Select velocity input option -> Click 'Discuss on WhatsApp' -> Open WhatsApp sharing flow with diagnostic results embedded
Navigate to / -> Select measurement input option -> Select visibility input option -> Select velocity input option -> Click 'Recalculate' -> Return to the initial diagnostic state

features.name: Secure Enterprise Lead Capture
features.description: A protected contact form that lets users request a strategic review by submitting their name, corporate email, and company information.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill Full Name input field -> Fill Corporate Email input field -> Fill Company Name input field -> Complete Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA -> Click 'Request Strategic Review' -> See success message 'Request Received'
Navigate to / -> Submit the form with empty or invalid required inputs -> See validation error messages

features.name: Global Navigation
features.description: Sticky header navigation that helps users move around the landing page and access the contact section from multiple entry points.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click logo -> Scroll to top of the page
Navigate to / -> Click navigation links -> Scroll to the corresponding sections
Navigate to / -> Click hamburger menu on mobile -> Open the mobile navigation drawer
Navigate to / -> Click primary CTA button -> Scroll to the contact form
